speaker: Doctor
text: I need to ask a few critical questions to understand the severity of your leg pain and check for signs of infection or bleeding disorders. Have you noticed any swelling in your joints, or does the pain get worse when you move your legs? Also, have you seen any petechiae (tiny red spots) or excessive bleeding from your gums or nose?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukemia (likely Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia).

Given the combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe bone pain in a young child, I suspect a hematologic malignancy. I need to confirm this immediately: REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential and REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear. Please also REQUEST IMAGES for a skeletal survey if the blood work is inconclusive.
